notes: U2 replace was colour/material only and 'small green box beside the plaque' was ambiguous among several green boxes (red boxes sit directly beside the plaque); now the leftmost green box beside the red boxes, replaced by a ceramic vase. U3 mask is the whole sign plate and its lettering is already gold-tan, so the edit is now a material change of the whole sign (mask unchanged). U1 verified.
